notes.content:

The third game I was working on was abandoned in a moment of indecision because it wasn't interesting enough.
Now it's time for the fourth game, which I hope will be dark, tense, and a little bit scary.

notes.title: The 3rd game
notes.content:
目前所做的僅是一點點的「想法」, 最後會不會實現還是言之尚早。
1. 盡可能減少場景轉換, 將室外與室內放在同一場景中。
2. 加入時間段, 不同的時間段會有不同的劇情供玩家選擇觸發與否。
3. 角色會隨劇情走向改變容貌或服飾, 問題在於我能否用拙劣的畫功處理龐大的繪圖工作。

What I've done so far is just a little "idea", it's still too early to say if it will be realised in the end.

1. Minimise scene transitions as much as possible, and put outdoors and indoors in the same scene.

2. Include time slots, and different time slots will have different episodes for the player to choose whether or not to trigger them.

3. Characters will change their looks or costumes as the episode progresses, the question is whether or not I'll be able to handle the huge amount of drawing work with my poor drawing skills.
